newsitem.title: GERMANY: German MG denies chief moving to Holzmann.
newsitem.headline: German MG denies chief moving to Holzmann.

text.p: Germany's Metallgesellschaft AG on Friday denied a report that its management board chairman Kajo Neukirchen may leave to head building concern Philipp Holzmann AG.
"The speculation is complete nonsense", a Metallgesellshaft spokesman told Reuters in response to enquiries.
Mass circulation daily "Bild", quoting the Munich-based news service "dossier B", reported that Holzmann's chief executive Lothar Mayer faced dismissal because of losses on a real estate project.
It added that Neukirchen was being viewed as a possible successor to Mayer.
A Holzmann spokesman earlier said he could not comment on the report ahead of a report on the losses due to be presented to Holzmann's supervisory board next Thursday.

Holzmann ran into financial problems in 1995, posting an unexpected loss of 443 million marks which forced it to omit its dividend payout. At the root of its problems were 458 million marks of write-downs on its property portfolio.
